restrictions: Each production D1 mutation is an exact single-row operation and must report changes=1 before advancing.
Do not use whole-account DELETE, D1 import/file mode, migrations, model requests, payments or storage-failure injection.
Review POST must be performed through the real production UI; this package never seeds review events or heads.
Null expiry restoration occurs before any R2 deletion and is fixture-state transition, not restoration of deleted images.
Seeded started/failed audit row remains explicitly synthetic; genuine cleanup creates separate actual completed audit attempts.
Immutable test classification, machine source and human review history are retained; do not hard-delete them.
